productVision.problem: Solo operators and 1-5 person agencies abandon CRMs within 30 days because data entry and pipeline hygiene break their flow.
productVision.productPromise: Your inbox is your CRM. We draft the next reply; you click send.
productVision.whyNow: AI-drafted replies are now reliable enough that the user never needs to see a contact record.
differentiation: Zero forms, zero pipeline stages, zero required fields.
BYOK model keys — the user's data and their AI key, not ours.
successMetrics: Activation in <5 minutes from sign-up to first drafted reply.

prd.overview: Faceless CRM ingests Gmail/Outlook threads, ranks the next-best-action, and presents a one-line nudge with a drafted reply.
goals: Make the system usable inside 5 minutes of sign-up.
Surface the next best action without asking the user to update fields.
Respect user privacy: BYOK, no inbox content in logs.
nonGoals: Build a team-collaboration mode in MVP.

personas.name: Dev — 4-person AI agency owner
personas.summary: Wants accountability without nagging the team.

requirements.text: OAuth-based ingest for Gmail and Outlook threads.
Generate a draft reply per nudge using the user's BYOK model key.
Nudge feed sorted by next-best-action score.
No raw inbox content in logs or audit metadata.

userJourneys.title: First inbox connect
steps: See first nudge with drafted reply

userJourneys.title: Daily morning review
steps: Send drafts with one edit each

explicitCuts.reason: Defeats the 'faceless' promise; contacts are inferred.

userStories.title: Connect inbox
userStories.story: As a solo consultant I want to connect my Gmail inbox so that the system can surface relevant nudges.
acceptanceCriteria: First nudge appears within 5 minutes of connect.
Connection state survives a page refresh.

userStories.title: Receive drafted reply
userStories.story: As a solo consultant I want each nudge to come with a drafted reply so that I can send in one click.
acceptanceCriteria: Draft addresses the correct sender by name.
Tone matches the user's recent sent items.
Draft can be edited inline before sending.

userStories.title: Snooze a nudge
userStories.story: As a solo consultant I want to snooze a nudge until tomorrow so that I can act on it later without losing it.
acceptanceCriteria: Snoozed nudges re-appear at the chosen time in the user's timezone.

userStories.title: Dismiss in bulk
userStories.story: As an agency owner I want to dismiss many nudges at once so that I can clear noise quickly.

userStories.title: Bring my own model key
userStories.story: As an agency owner I want to use my own OpenAI/Anthropic key so that my data stays under my control.
acceptanceCriteria: Key is stored encrypted at rest.
Key is never echoed back to the browser.

components.name: Embedding store
components.responsibility: Vector index of thread chunks for retrieval.

components.name: Draft generator
components.responsibility: LLM call (BYOK) to produce reply drafts.

dataFlow: Inbox → ingest queue → chunker → embeddings → nudge engine → web client (BYOK draft on demand).
storage: Postgres for thread metadata and nudge state.
Object store for OAuth refresh tokens (encrypted).
security: BYOK secrets are never logged or returned to the browser.
Refresh tokens encrypted at rest with per-tenant DEK.
No raw inbox content in logs or audit metadata.
scalabilityAssumptions: <100k threads per tenant in the first 6 months.

pages.name: Nudge feed
pages.purpose: Daily list of next actions with drafted replies.

pages.name: Draft pane
pages.purpose: Edit and send a drafted reply inline.

pages.name: Settings
pages.purpose: BYOK key management + inbox connection state.

prototypeBrief.demoScenario: Maya signs up, sees the privacy explainer, connects Gmail in under 60s, and sends her first AI-drafted reply within 5 minutes.

agentCritiques.comment: Explicit cuts are sharp; consider also cutting bulk import to keep onboarding fast.
Privacy explainer should appear before OAuth, not after, to avoid trust drop-off.
agentCritiques.suggestion: Move privacy explainer to step 2 of the first-connect flow.

agentCritiques.comment: Embedding store choice (pgvector) should be revisited once thread volume crosses 1M.
Add a non-functional requirement for OAuth refresh-token rotation cadence.
DraftEditor needs an empty-state when no nudges are ready.
Snooze story should specify timezone handling explicitly.
agentCritiques.suggestion: Add an AC: 'Snoozed nudges re-appear in the user's stored timezone.'

agentCritiques.comment: Add a leading indicator for week 1 (e.g. signup→OAuth conversion).

rationale: Mode: PROCEED — running drafting + critique pass.
Drafting and critique pass produced 7 cross-agent critiques across 7 roles.
